subject.title: fix(onepassword): key pending authorizations by tool call id only

question: Should authorization metadata preservation be guaranteed generically by core before-tool-call hook composition, or should the 1Password plugin use a separate correlation mechanism that cannot be replaced by another hook?
rationale: Both directions can fix the regression, but choosing the permanent ownership and security contract affects every plugin that rewrites tool parameters and cannot safely be inferred from this extension-only patch.

options.title: Harden core composition
options.body: Make each hook observe and preserve the accumulated parameters, add multi-hook core tests, and keep the 1Password UUID correlation on that explicit contract.

options.title: Use plugin-local correlation
options.body: Replace adjusted-parameter correlation with a 1Password-owned mechanism that remains collision-safe across sessions and cannot be forged or removed by other hooks.

options.title: Pause this approach
options.body: Leave the production regression unresolved until the authorization-boundary owner selects and documents a different correlation contract.

recommendation.title: Harden core composition
recommendation.body: Make each hook observe and preserve the accumulated parameters, add multi-hook core tests, and keep the 1Password UUID correlation on that explicit contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged plugin authorization design and have the strongest concrete history on the affected broker boundary.
